calculation.description: Contrarian 20-day return, amplified when price is near the upper or lower edge of its trailing 60-day range. Higher values favor recent losers and assets at range extremes, consistent with cross-asset exhaustion/reversal over the 10-day allocation horizon.

validation.regime_notes: Aggregate reversal IC passes decisively, with strong 2025 and 2029 results but near-zero 2027 result; regime dependence is material. The positive 20-day decay suggests the reversal may persist beyond the nominal 10-day horizon. Use conservatively alongside directional trend factors and defensive conditioning. Cross-sectional observations require at least 8 valid instruments; no observation-level future data was used in signal construction.
